title: Localization Resource Separation & Stable Text Keys
objective: Separate localizable player-facing text from executable conditions/actions using stable text/resource keys, locale fallback rules, missing-translation diagnostics and deterministic locale projection. Narrative behavior must remain identical across locales except for explicitly localized presentation.

scope.purpose: Separate localizable presentation text from executable content behavior through stable text/resource keys and deterministic locale projection.
scope.completion_gate: Player-facing text is structurally separated from executable conditions/actions, locale projection is deterministic with explicit fallback/diagnostics, and narrative behavior remains identical across locales except explicitly localized presentation.

selection_boundaries: CNI-09 is completed_verified before CNI-10 implementation.
CNI-10 may define structural narrative/content localization seams but does not become final product-wide localization/accessibility authority; SMB-16 retains that role.
Localization must not alter executable narrative conditions, actions or canonical owner-domain behavior.
No translation provider/workflow, supported-locale catalog, or community-translation policy is invented by this tranche.
CNI-11+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Establish causal CNI-10 RED on the authorized application branch, then implement the minimum deterministic text-resource projection contract.
